steps.en: Officer picks a different vehicle registration type on the notice edit screen
steps.id: Officer memilih vehicle registration type lain di layar edit notice

steps.en: A confirmation dialog appears asking whether to change the type
steps.id: Dialog konfirmasi muncul dan menanyakan apakah tipe mau diubah

steps.en: Yes continues the change; No closes the dialog and keeps the old value
steps.id: Yes melanjutkan perubahan; No menutup dialog dan nilai lama tetap
